PM Modi's Indonesia visit focuses on EV industry and regional strategy

Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Indonesia aimed to bolster India's Electric Vehicle (EV) industry, particularly concerning nickel resources. The trip also involved discussions on regional strategy in the Indo-Pacific, potentially impacting geopolitical dynamics with China. The visit highlighted India's growing influence and strategic partnerships in the region.
